categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in manufacturing and sales of electronic components, data storage and processing equipment, wired communication machinery, wires and cables, machinery equipment, office machines, copper secondary processing, electrical wholesale and retail, precision instruments wholesale and retail, software wholesale and retail, electronic materials wholesale and retail, manufacturing export, software services, and electronic information supply services. Its main products include twisted copper wires, 3C product wires, and 3C connection assembly products, with a focus on data transmission cables and high-frequency cables for various applications including automotive, medical, server, and industrial uses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing processes such as twisting copper wires, extrusion insulation, winding, braiding, twisting pairs, assembly, secondary extrusion, braiding, sheathing, inspection, and packaging. It emphasizes high-frequency cable technology including HDMI 2.1, DisplayPort 2.1, USB4.0, Thunderbolt, and medical-grade ultra-fine coaxial cables. The company also integrates sustainable production methods, including the use of recycled materials and energy-efficient manufacturing processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves customers primarily in the 3C (computer, communication, consumer electronics) industry, automotive, medical equipment, server and cloud computing, industrial automation, and gaming sectors. Its major end markets are in Asia, with key customers including global 3C product manufacturers and emerging markets in automotive electronics, medical devices, and AI-related applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's main production bases and sales markets are located in mainland China, with its headquarters in Hsinchu County, Taiwan. It primarily serves the Asian market but also has overseas subsidiaries and investments, including in Hong Kong and Dongguan. The company monitors global economic and geopolitical developments, especially US-China trade relations, which impact its operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembly of electronic wires and cables. It has expanded upstream into copper wire processing and maintains close relationships with raw material suppliers. It also provides downstream solutions by collaborating with OEMs and ODMs for customized cable products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-frequency data transmission cables, automotive wiring harnesses, medical cables, and AI-related applications. It focuses on product innovation, quality improvement, and sustainable development by integrating recycled materials and energy-saving processes. The company aims to expand into niche markets such as medical, automotive, industrial automation, and server cables, while enhancing production efficiency through smart manufacturing and digital data analysis.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of various types of wires, cables, and assembled connection products. The company also derives income from investments in subsidiaries and related companies. It does not disclose subscription or licensing models, focusing instead on manufacturing and wholesale/retail sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces intense competition in the 3C cable market with pressure on pricing and product life cycles. It differentiates itself by focusing on high-frequency, high-value-added products and maintaining strong customer relationships with global 3C manufacturers. The company positions itself as a professional, high-quality cable manufacturer with capabilities in customized production and advanced technology integration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the most recent fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$3.98 billion, a 34.75% increase from the prior year. Despite revenue growth, it recorded a net loss of NT$59.5 million, an improvement over the previous year's larger loss. The company has a total asset base of about NT$2.31 billion and equity of NT$1.23 billion, with a stable capital structure and ongoing efforts to improve profitability and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, customized cable solutions with advanced technology such as USB4.0, HDMI 2.1, and medical-grade cables. It offers comprehensive technical consulting, efficient delivery systems, and continuous product diversification. Its commitment to sustainable manufacturing, including recycled materials and energy-saving processes, along with strong R&D capabilities, provides competitive differentiation and value to customers.
